articles.title: Lampsy Health raises €1.1M to shine a light on undetected night-time seizures
Lampsy raises €1.1M to take its seizure-detecting lamp to Europe and UK
Lisbon's Lampsy Health raises €1.1 million for its AI bedside lamp that detects epileptic seizures during sleep

brief.essentiel: Lampsy Health has closed a €1.1 million funding round to finance the commercial launch and distribution of its product in Europe and the UK.
points: The smart lamp is embedded with a small built-in camera and a proprietary artificial intelligence algorithm.
The Portuguese startup has developed a lamp that monitors for epileptic seizures during sleep.
It detects movements that may indicate a seizure with over 97 per cent accuracy and automatically alerts emergency contacts.
A computer vision and AI system running on the device itself recognises the patterns associated with tonic-clonic seizures.

articles.title: Belgian cyber insurance startup Inqase raises €1M

brief.essentiel: Belgian cyber insurance startup Inqase has raised €1 million in a funding round, it said today.
points: Inqase provides cyber insurance for SMEs, with its offering spanning insurance, with continuous risk monitoring and 24/7 incident response.
The funding round was led by Brussels-based VC ScaleFund, alongside invest.bw, with Seeder Fund and business angels, including Belgian serial entrepreneur Philippe Van Ophem also participating.
Its services are distributed through brokers, IT service providers and accounting firms.
Inqase, which launched this year, was founded by Rodolphe Lechat, Guillaume Deterville and Drilon Saraqini, who have previously built and sold companies.

articles.title: Beyond the taboo: Polari Labs brings biotech innovation to anorectal health

brief.essentiel: London-based biotech and sexual wellness startup Polari Labs has raised funding.
points: Founded in 2023, the company develops science-led consumer products for anorectal health, an area historically underserved by both medical research and commercial innovation.
Polari Labs has spent several years developing its flagship product, A-BALL, a single-use, patent-pending hydrogel insert designed to replace conventional anal douching.

The product aims to reduce preparation time for anal sex from around 20–30 minutes to 30 seconds, addressing the physical discomfort, anxiety and lack of spontaneity associated with conventional douching.
Polari Labs uses polymers already found in products such as suppositories and sexual lubricants, including gelatine and alginate.

articles.title: Papa John’s pizza order first UK cardless payment by AI agent

brief.essentiel: An AI agent has paid for Papa John’s pizzas directly from a customer’s bank account via cardless payment technology in a trial, which the tech provider says is the first of its kind.
points: TrueLayer , the open banking tech provider, says it was the first time an AI agent had paid a UK retailer this way.
The pilot was part of the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) AI regulatory sandbox trials, to test that an AI agent could make payments within limits agreed by the customer.
The trial comes amid AI agents expected to handle a growing share of online shopping.
The trial saw Papa John’s AI agent help the customer with their order, and then pay straight from the bank account the customer linked to their Papa John’s account.

articles.title: Cutting the cord: How Willo is taking wireless power into the third dimension

brief.essentiel: What if robots could charge while moving, without needing to align with a charging pad or plug into a cable?
points: I covered the company's €2.9 million funding round earlier this year, when I interviewed co-founder Marko Voutilainen at my office during a visit to Berlin.
Or you could simply walk into a room and have your laptop or mobile phone start charging automatically, wherever you placed it?

At Slush in Helsinki last week, I caught up with Harri Santamala, co-founder and CEO of Willo Technologies , and Nam Ha-Van, co-founder and CTO, and other team members for a fascinating demo of their wireless power tech.
Both our offices are housed in former industrial factories, although theirs are considerably more salubrious.
